name: dsh_list_sessions
description: List DSH Web Sessions whose working directory is inside the bridge workspace allowlist. Same sessions the human sees in the DSH sidebar.

cwd.description: Optional absolute directory filter (must be inside the allowlist).

query.description: Optional literal message-content search (max 500 characters; results are intersected with the allowlisted sessions).

name: dsh_create_session
description: Create a DSH Web Session in an allowlisted working directory. Resolves Host workspaceId (explicit > slug > resolveByPath(cwd)) so the session attaches into the named sidebar group instead of 未分组.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory; must be inside the bridge workspace allowlist. Used for allowlist checks and workspace resolution.

workspaceId.description: Optional Host workspace id. Must own the same canonical path as cwd; otherwise BAD_REQUEST.

workspaceSlug.description: Optional operator-configured workspace alias from workspaceSlugs. Mapped then path-checked against cwd.

model.description: Optional model selection: "provider/model" or an object {provider, model, reasoningEffort?}.

source.description: Optional provenance tag recorded by the bridge for this Session (bridge-local, not the Host origin). Default mcp; max 64 chars of [a-z0-9._-].

name: dsh_prompt
description: Send a prompt to a DSH Web Session. The human sees the message and the agent's activity live in the DSH Web UI.

text.description: Prompt text (required unless images are supplied).

delivery.description: queue starts/queues a turn; steer injects into the running turn. Default queue.

name: dsh_steer
description: Redirect a RUNNING DSH Web Session: inject a message into the turn that is executing right now so the agent changes course without waiting for the next turn. Fails with BAD_REQUEST when the Session is idle; use dsh_prompt in that case.

text.description: Steering text (required unless images are supplied).

images.description: Optional base64 images, same shape as dsh_prompt.

name: dsh_update_queue
description: Mutate one pending queue item of a DSH Web Session: edit its text, remove it, or steer it into the running turn. Read the queue item ids from dsh_get_status first.

itemId.description: Queue item id from dsh_get_status queue[].id.

text.description: Replacement text; required when kind is edit, forbidden otherwise.

name: dsh_cancel
description: Cancel the active turn of a DSH Web Session without dropping its pending inbox.

name: dsh_get_status
description: Read the run state of a DSH Web Session: running/active, event cursor, queue depth, and pending input.

name: dsh_get_projections
description: Read a sequenced projection snapshot for a DSH Web Session, optionally filtered to specific projection keys.

name: dsh_follow
description: Follow a DSH Web Session from a sequence cursor and return durable events (including tool calls and results) within a bounded timeout.

sinceSeq.description: Only return events with seq greater than this cursor.

name: dsh_read_workspace_file
description: Read a text/binary file (for example a RESULT.md) using a path relative to the session cwd. Absolute paths and traversal outside the session cwd are rejected.

sessionId.description: Session whose cwd is the base directory.

cwd.description: Explicit absolute base directory (alternative to sessionId).

path.description: Path relative to the base directory.

name: dsh_list_artifacts
description: List deliverable/result files under the session cwd, filtered by glob patterns (default: RESULT/markdown/json files).

glob.description: Glob pattern (or array of patterns) relative to the base directory, supporting *, ? and **.

name: dsh_list_workspaces
description: List Host workspaces whose path is inside the bridge allowlist (sidebar tree JSON; read-only).

cwd.description: Optional: only return the workspace that owns this allowlisted path.

includeSessionIds.description: When true, include sessionIds (may be long). Default false.

sessionIdLimit.description: Max sessionIds to return per workspace when includeSessionIds is true. Default 50, max 500.
